observations.name: isolated_amd_hardware_sourceover
observations.interpretation: The raw AMD/ANGLE source-over blend path is not sufficient to explain the large final screenshot mismatch.

observations.name: single_variable_y_orientation_repair
observations.change_only: vertex shader uv=vec2(p.x,1.-p.y) -> uv=p while UNPACK_FLIP_Y_WEBGL remains enabled
observations.causal_conclusion: The double Y-flip/orientation contradiction is a real causal defect in the screenshot gate/harness, responsible for roughly half of the observed mismatch by these metrics. It is not the complete cause.

remaining_hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: The gate's 1536x1024 -> 120x80 extreme downscale compares Chrome DOM image-resampling against WebGL LINEAR texture sampling, creating a large final-pixel confound independent of source-over correctness.
remaining_hypotheses_ranked.discriminator: Repeat the same gate with only Y fixed and substantially larger render size; do not mutate live source.

remaining_hypotheses_ranked.hypothesis: Residual DOM-vs-WebGL color/compositing semantics differ (color space, premultiplication, browser raster path).
remaining_hypotheses_ranked.discriminator: Only if scale does not explain the remainder: isolate same-size/no-resample and opaque-vs-alpha controls before any production integration.
